claim_scope: ZDEX purchase, burn, fee-allocation, and tokenomics-lane receipt verifiers construct authority witnesses only from exact owned snapshots established before an untrusted receipt-verifier callback.
failure_modes: a caller mutates aliased receipt bytes during verification so the witness names unauthenticated bytes
a callback mutates aliased route, release, occurrence, journal, effect, or policy fields after their checks
a hostile scalar subclass controls equality or canonicalization during authority binding
a rejected hostile scalar reaches the external receipt verifier
a purchase witness remains usable after its authenticated effects are redirected

aaa.reason: Each regression arranges one hostile alias or scalar, acts through one public verifier boundary, and asserts the exact owned witness or the exact pre-callback rejection with no verifier call.

reject_is_noop.reason: The receipt boundaries are pure. Exact-type rejection produces no authority witness or economic effect and the tests assert that the external receipt verifier is not called.

mutations.description: derive a receipt digest from the caller-owned envelope after the callback
construct fee witness fields from caller-owned governed and candidate objects after verification
construct burn coordinator witness fields from aliased release and receipt objects
allow a value-equal string subclass into canonical receipt bindings
allow a verified purchase witness to authorize effects redirected after receipt verification

nonclaims: This packet proves no cryptographic receipt, guest image, recursive composition, or deployed verifier correctness.
The tests close scoped same-process aliasing and hostile-scalar attacks at three Python receipt boundaries; they do not prove all economic semantics or all value movement.
Named mutation killers are reviewed semantic mutants; no automated mutation score is claimed.
This change grants no settlement, publication, migration, writer-rotation, or production authority.
Production authority remains NONE and whole-economy safety remains unproved.
